name: NestSave-Savings-Planner
description: Private, 100% offline-first savings goal planner & wealth engine for Web and Android. Indian Bank RD/FD calculators, 1-click plan recalibration, biometric lock, zero cloud tracking.

paragraphs: NestSave plans, tracks, and protects your financial goals entirely on your personal device. No accounts. No cloud databases. No bank sync. No tracking.
Available as a Web App, offline PWA, and 100% native Android application (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + SQLite Room).

100% Private & Local-First: Your financial numbers, transactions, salaries, and targets are never uploaded to any server. Everything is stored in your device's private sandbox (IndexedDB on Web, SQLite Room on Android).
features: Zero Cloud Databases: No Firebase, AWS RDS, Supabase, or external API endpoints.
Zero Third-Party Trackers: No Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or telemetry SDKs.
Zero Internet Permissions Required: The native Android application operates with zero network socket permissions.
100% Cryptographic Security: Vault exports use client-side AES-GCM 256-bit encryption derived via PBKDF2 with SHA-256 salts.

requirements.text: Most personal finance apps have become ad-laden data brokers: they demand bank login credentials, store transaction histories in unencrypted third-party clouds, and sell financial insights to credit card companies.
